notes.title: PEAK V2.4425 — FULL UPDATE OVERVIEW
notes.content:
V2.4425 marks the most expansive and transformative update in PEAK history. From new game modes to a full UI overhaul, new weapon balances, and deeper faction immersion, this version redefines the gameplay experience across the board.

MAJOR ADDITIONS
New Game Mode: Team Deathmatch
15-minute match timer with infinite respawns.

High-intensity, fast-paced action for close combat encounters.

Launches on the brand-new AUTHORITY map.

New Map: AUTHORITY
Urban industrial environment tailored for Team Deathmatch.

Open sky, layered verticality, and clean visual layout.

Cinematic Map Introductions
Each map now includes a custom intro cinematic to establish location and mood before match start.

18 New INK CORP Ranks
A full progression tier added to INK CORP.

Clean, green-themed iconography and escalating design for each rank.

COMBAT + GAMEPLAY CHANGES
Weapon Rebalancing & Audio Enhancements
AK4 has been converted into a suppressed variant.

AKC now features brand-new, sharper weapon sound effects.

G90 firing audio updated for crisper and more realistic impact.

STG fire rate reduced, but damage increased, focusing it into a high-impact rifle.

1911 Handgun buffed with improved damage and tighter recoil for short-range reliability.

Shotgun Class (C612, ITA12, NAT) has been buffed — increased damage and tighter spread at close range.

Spawn System Improvements
Faster load-in times when entering a match.

Reduced delay between player death and re-entry.

Pickup System Removed
Death bags and dropped item pickups have been removed for a cleaner, more tactical combat loop.

Voice Communication Update
In-game text chat has been removed.

Voice chat functionality is nearing completion and will roll out shortly.

UI + MENU UPGRADES
Main Menu Overhaul
Brand-new layout with smooth animations and transitions.

Better navigation and customization tools.

New Team Select Experience
Redesigned interfaces for INK CORP and PEAK.53.

Includes new team-specific voice lines for immersive entry.

UI Enhancements Across the Game
New HUD elements.

Refreshed scoreboard, weapon select, and match flow indicators.

FACTION + VISUAL UPDATES
New Character Skins
INK CORP and PEAK.53 both receive new visual loadouts.

Updated texture work and more tactical gear options.

Weapon & Item Icons Reworked
All weapons and holdables now feature high-detail, line-drawn icon designs for consistency and clarity.

LEVEL + LIGHTING IMPROVEMENTS
Lighting Passes on Existing Maps
GOSAN and MIXER levels now feature improved lighting for atmosphere and clarity.

Visual updates focus on depth, shadow accuracy, and tone balance.

FEATURES REMOVED
In-Game Text Chat: Fully removed to streamline player communication and reduce distractions.

Death Bags + Pickups: Eliminated to improve gameplay fluidity and focus.

V2.4425 is a statement update. Faster. Smarter. Sharper. Whether you're rising through the new INK ranks, testing the STG’s raw power, or storming AUTHORITY in Team Deathmatch — this version delivers everything players have asked for and more.

notes.title: PEAK.53 – UPDATE V2.4342
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest improvements and additions to PEAK.53. This update focuses on expanding map content, enhancing audio and visual immersion, refining character systems, and fixing key gameplay issues.

HUNT:
Introduced a new map inspired by FOXHUNT. This is an original design that captures the essence of classic tactical gameplay (note: not a replica of SOCOM 2: Navy Seals).

GOSAN
A returning favorite from the early days of PEAK.53. The original layout has been preserved with updated fixes for a smoother experience.

Audio Enhancements:
Updated grass footstep sounds to include new layering with equipment-based audio for a more immersive experience.

Added new voice lines for INK CORP, tailored to match recent faction and map updates.

Character & Outfit Updates:
New outfits added for both INK CORP and P53 factions.

INK CORP default character now includes a free vest and jacket by default.

Introduced randomized skins for players who have not purchased cosmetic items.

Additional INK character customization options are in development and will be released soon.

Gameplay Improvements:
Character scale has been slightly increased for improved screen presence.

Crosshair size has been adjusted for better visibility and targeting.

Resolved an issue with prone functionality on the INK CORP side.

Map Fixes:
Addressed bugs and made refinements on the following maps:

GOSAN

HOOK

RIG

Upcoming Feature (Work in Progress)
Skin Drop System (In Development)
A system is currently being developed that will offer players a 10% chance to receive a skin at the end of each match. This feature is not yet live but is nearing completion.

Thank you for your continued support of PEAK.53. We’re excited about these changes and look forward to hearing your feedback. Stay sharp, and we’ll see you on the field.

notes.title: PEAK.53 UPDATE V2.427
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of PEAK.53 V2.427, packed with new features, fixes, and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s a breakdown of everything included in this update:

New Features:

*XROADS Map Added: Inspired by the legendary SOCOM 2 Navy SEALs' "Crossroads," this map is now available, delivering intense and tactical gameplay.

*CATHEDRAL Map Added: Explore the new Cathedral map! While bomb and player spawn locations remain unchanged, expect updates with refined locations soon.

*Settings Menu Overhaul: A brand-new settings menu has been introduced, now accessible directly from the main menu. This update also includes a redesigned interface for better usability.

*Emote Button Added: Players can now configure an emote button directly in the settings, allowing for quicker access to emotes during gameplay.

*New Compass Icons: Enhanced compass and tooltip bar with dedicated icons for PEAK and INK plant sites, improving objective navigation.

*All Maps Feature New Intro Videos: Fresh cinematic intros have been added to every map. Please note that these are subject to future revisions.

Bug Fixes and Improvements:

*Controller Menu Fixes: Resolved sticking and freezing issues when navigating menus with controllers.
Multiple Key Bindings: Fixed settings to allow multiple keys to be assigned to the same action or purpose, giving players greater flexibility in customization.

*Level Adjustments: Addressed various level-related issues for Aurora, XROADS, and other maps, including minor collision fixes.

*Secondary Ban Check: Added an extra layer of security for banned players. Those attempting to join a room or create their own servers will experience an automatic game crash.

*Clan Optimizations: Improved performance and loading times when clans join levels, ensuring a smoother experience.

*Database Updates: Resolved issues with instant bans when servers interact with the database, ensuring a more reliable banning system.

Looking Ahead
With this update, we’ve taken significant strides in refining PEAK.53. Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping these improvements, and we look forward to bringing even more exciting updates in the near future.

Thank you for being part of the PEAK.53 journey! See you in the game!

notes.title: PEAK.53 Holiday Update – Festive Features and Fixes
notes.content:
This holiday season, PEAK.53 is getting a festive makeover! Each map now includes a hidden Christmas tree to bring some holiday cheer. Grenades have been replaced with snowballs, adding a frosty twist to your gameplay. On snow maps, you’ll find hidden snowmen that play cheerful holiday music when discovered, and grenade explosions now come with a fun snow effect. The main menu and game screens have also been updated with a festive holiday theme to get you into the spirit. Additionally, we’ve launched a special holiday edition of the BRECKENRIDGE map for you to explore.

We’re excited to announce the addition of rocket launchers, which are now ready for testing in this update!

Several important fixes and improvements have been implemented as well. The issue causing pistols to fire backward has been resolved, and we’ve fixed the scope and zoom issues that had been causing players trouble (though additional testing on servers is still required). Camera positions have also been updated to replicate SOCOM’s nostalgic style, bringing a classic feel to your gameplay.

Celebrate the holidays with PEAK.53 and enjoy all the frosty surprises we’ve added. Your continued support helps us grow and improve—thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: PEAK.53 Launch Update - 11/30/2024
notes.content:
Gameplay Fixes & Improvements

*Ladder Climbing Fix: Addressed issues with non-hosted players climbing ladders. (Still undergoing further testing for perfection.)

*Breach Wall/Bridge System: Breach walls and bridges now respawn properly at the start of every round, ensuring consistent gameplay mechanics.

*Automatic Door Reset: All doors now close automatically and reset to the closed position at the beginning of each round for a more streamlined experience.

*Thermal Sights Added: Players can now toggle thermal sights while scoped, providing enhanced visibility in colder climates and nighttime settings.

New Map – DUST:
A brand-new map inspired by SOCOM Navy SEALs 2’s Desert Glory. This iconic environment has been faithfully recreated with enhancements to fit PEAK.53’s tactical gameplay style.

Weapon Overhauls:
*F90 Overhaul - New fire mode change audio for an immersive experience.
Increased damage output while slightly reducing the fire rate for better balance.

*552 Overhaul - Updated fire mode change audio.
Increased damage alongside a faster fire rate to maintain weapon viability in intense engagements.

*Crosshair Enhancements:
Crosshair color-changing mechanics reintroduced:
Red when aiming at enemies.
Blue when aiming at friendly teammates, helping players make better split-second decisions during firefights.

*Camera Adjustments:
Fixed issues where players were forced into awkward camera positions near walls or overhead objects.
Adjusted crosshair height on the camera for improved clarity and precision when lining up shots.

*New Features
Emote System: Introducing a fun new feature where players can freely use single emotes during gameplay. Choose from a variety of emotes like laugh, taunt, cry, or flex to interact or taunt your opponents.

notes.title: PEAK.53 Update V2.2048(3rd).
notes.content:
New Additions:
RIG, our newest map inspired by SOCOM 2’s FROSTFIRE, is now live. This map brings intense close-quarters action and strategic challenges that enhance the tactical gameplay experience.

HOOK Map Improvements:
Significant updates have been made to the HOOK map, addressing collision issues in the arches, raising walls, and fixing invisible barriers in key areas like the hostage building. Additionally, SEAL rocks on the hill and the central tower now feature a new rooftop, adding dynamic layers to the map's strategies.

SNOWDAY Map Fixes:
The SNOWDAY map received a major overhaul with corrections to pipe crawlspaces, jump-up areas in terrorist buildings, and SEAL mountain slopes. A new slope has been added to the middle mountain, and invisible collisions at the terrorist spawn have been resolved. Doorways have also been adjusted for smoother flow during gameplay.

MALL Map Update:
Players will notice improved navigation with fixed stair collisions, ensuring smoother movement throughout the map.

Weapons & Equipment
Weapons have been rebalanced and improved:

- The HK joins the INK CORP side with enhanced sounds and a slight damage increase.
- Sniper rifles now deliver 100% damage, making them deadly precision tools.
- The AKC has been refined with increased damage and improved fire sound effects.

Enhanced Gameplay Features:
Ladder climbing speeds have been increased, and client-side issues with climbing have been resolved for more fluid gameplay. Night vision functionality has been reworked for better visibility, and scoped players can now see bombs on other players’ backs, addressing a long-standing issue.

New Systems:
To streamline transitions, client/server travel with the host after map selection has been introduced, ensuring seamless flow between rounds.

notes.title: PEAK.53 UPDATE V2.4078
notes.content:
PEAK.53 Update Announcement - Major Fixes & Feature Updates!

Hello PEAK.53 Community,

We’re excited to bring you a new round of updates and improvements to PEAK.53! Since development began in July 2022, your feedback has been essential to helping us create a more immersive and action-packed experience. With 41 updates in 2024 alone, we’re committed to refining every detail. This latest update is one of our biggest yet, packed with new features, polished gameplay, and critical optimizations. Here’s everything that’s new:

Key New Features
Passworded Rooms & Player-Created Sessions
You can now create and host custom rooms that appear on the server list, complete with password protection for privacy. Whether you’re playing with friends or going head-to-head with rivals, you’ll feel at home.

Clan Badges & Systems
Our Clan System is now live! Clan badges will appear next to player names in both dedicated and player-created rooms, letting you represent your clan with pride.

Rocket Launcher Addition
A powerful Rocket Launcher has been added, bringing explosive action to both breach scenarios and PvP battles, perfect for those wanting a dynamic edge in tactical gameplay.

Enhanced Door Mechanics
We’ve added the ability to open and close doors, giving players more tactical options and adding new depth to gameplay. Use this feature to create new paths, fortify your position, or add an element of surprise.

Enhanced Gameplay Experience
SOCOM 2 Map Replicas
We’re thrilled to introduce inspired replicas of classic SOCOM 2 maps:

Frostfire
Fish Hook
Desert Glory
Guidance
Crossroads
These maps bring nostalgic layouts combined with updated visuals and tactical features for both classic and new experiences.

UI/HUD Visual Updates
Key UI and HUD visuals, including ladder climbing, door interactions, and dancing animations, have been updated to provide a smoother, more immersive feel.

Increased Movement Speeds
Player movement speeds have been slightly increased for a faster and more responsive experience, enhancing both exploration and combat dynamics.

New Main Menu and UI Redesign
We’ve completely revamped the main menu and interface, featuring new backgrounds, an updated layout, and a more intuitive design to make accessing game features and settings even easier.

Cinematic Map Intros
Each SOCOM map now includes an immersive cinematic intro, setting the scene for your missions and adding depth to your gameplay experience.

Critical Fixes, Stability, & Optimizations
Scope and Zoom Bugs Addressed
Multiple scope and zoom-related bugs have been addressed, improving aiming accuracy and usability. Although one minor bug remains, we’re actively working to resolve it.

Scope/UI Stability Across Rounds
Scope and UI bugs that previously impacted visibility during player deaths or between rounds have been fixed, creating a seamless transition through each phase of play.

Refined Weapon Pickup System
The weapon pickup system has been fully refined. Players can now reliably pick up ammo, grenades, and other weapons without losing their primary weapon.

Adjusted Player Camera Angle
A slight adjustment to the player camera angle improves perspective and overall gameplay visuals.

Player Ban System
We’ve added a player ban system to maintain a positive gaming environment, giving moderators more control over disruptive behaviors.

Further Game Optimizations
We’ve made additional optimizations to improve game performance and stability, ensuring smoother play across different system setups. We’ll continue to fine-tune these optimizations as the game grows.

Ongoing Bug Fixes & Player Feedback Integration
Your input has been critical to shaping PEAK.53, and with every update, we address bugs and add features based on your feedback. Expect regular monthly updates as we continue this journey with the community’s help.

A Message to Our Community
PEAK.53 is an ongoing project, and we’re excited to grow it together. Your patience, support, and feedback have been crucial in helping us shape a game we’re proud of. As we continue developing, we’re dedicated to improving every aspect of your experience.

Join us on Discord for the latest updates, community discussions, and announcements. Your voices drive us forward, and we’re grateful to each of you for being part of PEAK.53.

Thank you for playing, and we look forward to many more exciting updates in the future!

- The PEAK.53 Team

Thanks for your continued support.

notes.title: PEAK.53 CLASSIC EDITION NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Maps:
Added "Summit": A thrilling addition to the roster, Summit promises dynamic gameplay with its strategic layout and varied terrain.
Removed Maps: Bid farewell to familiar battlegrounds as Forsaken, Cable, Arvada Heights, Heights Summer, Overtime, and Jericho make way for new adventures.

Weapons:
Removed Silenced Weapons: Say goodbye to the hushed menace of IW80E, AK76 RU, AKU, LT76, INK102, F90, M16, STG, M4M1, M416, M4A1, M4T, AK74, TG1224, and P53 SMG silenced variants, paving the way for a fresh arsenal.

Graphical Updates:
Enhanced Visuals: Prepare to be immersed like never before with an overhaul of graphics tailored for lower resolutions, complemented by clear, synced corner shaders and the nostalgic charm of PlayStation 2 visual effects.
Lighting Updates:

Atmospheric Ambiance: Dive into battles shrouded in mystery with lighting and deep fog reminiscent of SOCOM 2, Navy Seals, accompanied by the iconic PlayStation 2 fogs and skylighting for an authentic experience.

Animations and Characters:
Seamless Transitions: Enjoy smoother left and right pivoting changes, enhancing character movements for a more fluid and engaging gameplay experience.

Weapons Changes:
Balanced Combat: Brace yourself for intense gunfights as increased recoil, spread, and revised damage values promise a more challenging and rewarding battlefield. Additionally, weapons are now equipped with a star system, allowing players to identify community favorites.

Settings Changes:
Optimized Performance: Even at the lowest settings, expect superior performance without sacrificing visual quality, ensuring a seamless gaming experience for all players.

UI/HUD:
Polished Interface: Experience subtle yet impactful changes in the UI, weapon icons, and main menu appearances, streamlining navigation without compromising the game's identity. Bid farewell to introductory movies with instant level-loading for uninterrupted gameplay.
Crosshairs:

Iconic Precision: Rejoice as the timeless SOCOM crosshair returns, restoring the familiar sight of PEAK.53 and ensuring pinpoint accuracy in the heat of battle.
This comprehensive update breathes new life into Classic Editions, offering players an immersive journey through revamped maps, refined gameplay mechanics, and enhanced visual and auditory experiences. Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure filled with nostalgia and excitement as you explore the depths of tactical warfare in the world of SOCOM.

notes.title: PEAK.53 UDATE 11.20.21 v1709(Seasonal Update)
notes.content:
Peak Elite, 

Here is a list of additions, fixes and adjustments. Holiday season is upon us, we hope everyone enjoys playing Peak 53 and today's update, READY UP!

ADDITIONS:

-Lean is back in PEAK
-Added round "Warning Sound" when games begins
-Added "BEEP Sound" to C4 after placing

-Changed bomb item pickup to 'Santa Hat' during holiday season

-Changed main menu screen for holiday seasonal event

-Removed ALL clothing items/skins and replaced store with 4 new and 4 limited seasonal outfits per side + 17 seasonal weapon skins (old items removed and will not be available any longer)

-Fall damage decreased
-Greyed out name on death when looking at scoreboard
-Footstep sound/range has been reduced and fixed

-Made ambient audio music stop playing indoors
-Fixed double bomb wins - players will no longer receive an extra win on demolition
-Removed 'effects' in the settings menu
-Fix silenced weapon sound range
-Lowered cool down on gun hot system to 3 seconds instead of 8
-Removed C4 placement sound
-Increased all footstep sounds (louder)
-Fixed C4 placement on breach that was broken in back of Jericho
-Grenade throwing possible fix on server(release).
-Increased weapon flashlight intensity
-Fixed bone socket locations for C6-12
-Fixed bone socket location for LT76
-Fixed bone socket location for AR45
-Change AR45 overhaul - sounds, attachments, and mesh
-Added revolver 'Shadowhawk 6s’ to ELITE
-M4A1SD damage buff
-INK 102- AK added
-Post processing removal - players will not be allowed to change/alter their Post Process
-Scalability changes (Low, Medium, and Epic settings)
-Fixed 'breaking legs' from shorter heights
-Smoke fixed (now being seen on lower settings)
-Upper body momentum changes

-All stats are being reset globally

MAP FIXES ADDITIONS:

-FRISCO’ Map added (Socom, II: SUJO inspired)

-MALL: Fixed jump area right of Peak spawn to second floor and fixed getting stuck top middle metal walk way
-CROSSROADS: Blocked jumping on roof of jump wall area, getting stuck on boxes
-ARVADA HEIGHTS: Fixed getting stuck on doors and other scale-able issues

Happy Holidays from the Peak Elite Team!

notes.title: Peak 53 Update's Since Steam Release
notes.content:
Peak Elite,

There was a urgent update to fix some major bugs that interfered with game play and overall players experiences in game. Interfered with map flow and created unfair advantage's. 

Previous updates included a vote to kick, team kill auto kick system. 

We appreciate your patience and willingness to play as we work on every aspect of Peak 53. Keep providing feedback, continue to ready up and we will continue to grind this out. We want a heart pounding, hands sweaty, objective based experience. 

Hot Fix's & Additions:

Hot fix/ addition: 

-Double win( it’s fixed partially still a WIP). Still happens sometimes if you kill them after the bomb explodes/is defused. 

-Spawn player stacking fixed

-Server optimizations/upgrades to all current servers (should fix problem with floating grenades)

Ui/Server Counts:

-Fix added for player counts in server

Voting system(First Pass):

-Vote to kick(majority vote to kick a player) as well as if you team kill 3 players in certain amount of time you will get auto kicked. NOTE potential game breaking bugs from this first pass could result it the patch being reverted NOTE

Map fixes & Additions:

-Summit; Lighting fix

-Brush; Lowered ledges to shoot over around map, blocked non jumpable areas, able to get on top of garage, filth clean up and coverage left of Peak side spawn between cafe and Ink hostage building

-Abandoned; lighting fix, lowered ledges around map to shoot over

-Jericho; Removed bushes, fixed peak side breach wall, added cover in open area left of Ink spawn by breach building

-Mall; Fixed Peak side flat roof access to second floor, stuck on ramp right side of peak spawn leading up to second level, moved Peak spawns back to balance bomb pick up

-Manitou Springs; Removed a lot of brush in second and third levels, added more path ways and boats to river

Maps Added:

-Manitou Springs: Removed a lot of brush in second and third levels, added more path ways and boats to river
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/7c6897551f18dfd7798d407a8419635b616e268e.png

-Arvada Heights:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/4c1e895aeb0f1b3065d33b22db607068003a1b3e.png

-Aurora City Summer:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/3e90fd8b26815bb39376661f9e7ffb7aa5c37642.png

-Salt Mine:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/81aada8534464d5e8da8f4aec9c7b623b20b4ad3.png

CLANS:

Don't forget to invite your friends and clan members. build your clan up! You can also submit your clan logos to be added to the game to show off to all. 

Zenith Clan with the first logo submitted. You can add it to any where on your player.

(ZN)Zenith
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/2bb956e89c2c8f6958bd4a4de221529301f03c78.png

Customization:

Customization is a huge part of Peak 53, plans are to add many, many more options. Don't want to be a bald recruit for to long. The gear is purchasable in game through steam and funds will 100% go to peak 53's development, servers etc. With more customization to come with weapon skins and the workbench!

Recruits:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/08da6eb7c14314f60befc0fd399b17f97e36e09c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/2a47ed725667bce0c68f09962737b13c5ec5831d.png

Elite:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/340e95f58e17c3215ff95c40ef914dd3f3053a55.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/6213a14c791c66e764758e7ae0efdde05e386e86.jpg

Work Bench(coming soon):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43484678/a9036fd555fdf4ee7d44c201da4071fde232d07a.png

We appreciate everyone who has played, even those that are on the fence waiting on fixes, provided feedback and continues to support Peak 53. We know its a drawn out process waiting for updates & fixes however we assure you the Peak 53 team works relentlessly to release updates and hot fixes as soon as they can. We will be releasing another update this week with more fixes. 

Thank you again for your support and patience!

Team Peak Elite
